description: This file defines a React component named Toolbar for a Kanban board application. The component provides UI controls for exporting data, uploading CSV/Excel files, adding columns, toggling fullscreen mode, and performing undo operations related to CSV synchronization. It includes modal dialogs for file upload and confirmation prompts, and interacts with context hooks and external utility functions for handling the core logic.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate()
methods.description: Creates and downloads an Excel template for importing Kanban cards, with predefined columns and a sample task.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog for adding a new column to the Kanban board.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the new column form, adding the column via context and providing user feedback.

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Reads the uploaded Excel file, parses the first sheet, and displays a modal for selecting the target column for bulk upload.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Processes the user's column selection, converts Excel rows into card objects, filters and validates them, and inserts into the board.

methods.name: handleExportCardsCsv
methods.description: Exports current cards to a CSV file using utility functions and triggers the download.

methods.name: handleCsvFileSelected
methods.description: Reads a selected CSV file, produces a preview including row count and header checks, then displays a confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleConfirmCsvSync
methods.description: Performs CSV synchronization, updating existing cards or inserting new ones, and provides success/error feedback.

methods.name: handleUndoCsvSync
methods.description: Performs an undo operation for the last CSV synchronization, restoring previous state, with user notifications.

methods.name: Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })

ctags.name: Toolbar
ctags.pattern: /^function Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
